purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are prioritization signals, not measured search volumes and not proof of eligibility, insurance coverage or factual truth. Community discussion is discovery-only; material claims require current primary-source verification.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative prioritization, not measured search volume.

demand_signal.basis: Public questions repeatedly mix employment, own business and insurance routes when a person is injured while working. This is a qualitative discovery signal, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: The user must distinguish statutory social insurance conditions from collective-agreement insurance and private/business insurance, and must also distinguish sole-trader/own-company status from egenanstallning through an invoicing company.

miss_consequence.basis: An employee-only assumption can hide a potentially relevant statutory route, while an automatic-Afa assumption can send a business owner to an insurance route that may not cover them. Misclassifying an invoiced worker can also produce the wrong employer context.

source_fragmentation.basis: Work-injury dental cost criteria are described by Forsakringskassan, business-owner insurance context by Verksamt, invoiced-worker employer responsibility by Forsakringskassan, and collective-agreement coverage by Afa.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Natural wording such as 'driver eget', 'egenforetagare', 'egenanstalld' and 'faktureringsforetag' can sound interchangeable even though the relevant insurance/employer context is different.

steps_to_action.basis: A safe route must first identify the work/injury connection, preserve the statutory work-injury conditions, then verify actual social-insurance and separate business/private/collective coverage rather than guessing from actor label.

recurrence_signal.basis: The same misunderstanding appears in business-owner and mixed employee/business questions: users ask which insurance applies before they know which layer of insurance they are asking about.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The public work-injury dental route is currently actor-labeled as employee, while the truth conditions themselves are not expressed as an employee-only gate. The product also has no permanent regression separating an own-business user from an egenanstalld user whose invoicing company has employer responsibility.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Lock self-employed and egenanstalld worker contexts as separate synthetic regressions in the existing work-injury learning loop. Keep Forsakringskassan's statutory cost route separate from Afa and private/business insurance, and do not ship a public self-employed handoff until the existing same-shell runtime can preserve that distinction without weakening truth or privacy guards.
signals.truth_rule: Community wording is discovery only. Verify work-injury dental criteria with current Forsakringskassan primary guidance, egenanstalld employer responsibility with current Forsakringskassan guidance, business-owner insurance context with current Verksamt guidance, and any collective-agreement coverage with Afa or the responsible primary provider. Do not infer coverage, eligibility, amount or employer identity from actor labels alone.
